entities.name: Planar Chaos
entities.description: The forty-first Magic expansion, released February 2007 as the second set of the Time Spiral block, themed on the alternate present.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose temporal fabric is ripping, splintering into thousands of alternate histories.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A character who has lost his planeswalker's spark and still struggles to mend the planar rifts.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Ally of Teferi who helps mend the rifts.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Ally of Teferi who helps mend the rifts.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A wayward region restored to its natural place in Dominaria.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The destination of the trio's teleport, an alternate chaotic Dominaria.

entities.name: Time rifts
entities.description: Rifts that merged past and present and splintered the timeline into alternate histories.

events.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser restore the wayward region of Shiv to its natural place in Dominaria, healing one rift.
events.quote: he has already succeeded in restoring the wayward region of Shiv to its natural place in Dominaria, healing one rift.

events.summary: The trio attempts to teleport to Urborg and finds the chaos of an alternate Dominaria awaiting.
events.quote: But danger awaits them as the trio attempts to teleport to Urborg
